reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports the premise that copper segregation reduces corrosion resistance in AlCrTiV0.5Cux HEAs, but it provides no data on high-temperature oxidation resistance, mechanical strength, or the formation of a continuous protective oxide film. The link between minimized segregation and simultaneous enhancement of all three properties is therefore largely unsupported.
premises: Copper segregation in lightweight HEAs accelerates local corrosion
A homogeneous solid-solution microstructure minimizes copper segregation
Minimizing copper segregation enables a continuous, adherent passive oxide film of light-element oxides
This continuous oxide film simultaneously enhances corrosion resistance, mechanical strength, and high-temperature oxidation resistance
